_doc: Minimum frequency of application E (make frequency): CLI input apps/synthetic-app-e/synthetic-app-e.csv (phase model, characterized costs), arch/hermes-2x2.gml, first frequency 500 MHz, search parameters of rttools/__main__.py, link occupancy o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1), the default of rttools/modules/routing/router.py (HEADER_WAIT_CYCLES; wait measured by make -C ../zll contention). f* (network, bisection), f_CPU (CPU test, once) and the network check at f_CPU (final_check) and the minimum frequency for the .map file and for the Spiral Mapping.
